models.purpose: Authoritative Decimal position, cash, fee, and additive-cost accounting.
assumptions: all fills are authoritative and idempotent
limitations: FIFO tax lots are deliberately not represented; independent reconciliation uses FIFO
dependencies: pinned fee schedule inputs shared by primary and direct reference fee calculations

models.purpose: Causality-safe partial fills with declared fidelity and queue uncertainty.
assumptions: F0 bars have no queue claim
limitations: paper/modelled fill evidence is not observed endogenous impact
signed G5 supports F1 fully-funded long-only spot with explicit slippage/impact estimates; no passive queue or derivative promotion

models.purpose: Signed G6 fixed-intent spot execution counterfactuals, realistic friction and conditional capacity ranges.
assumptions: single-venue fully-funded long-only spot market IOC orders
fee is additive; spread, depth, impact and timing decompose execution price
implementation and opportunity shortfall are diagnostic, not additional deductions
nonnegative square-root participation impact with disjoint calibration/validation episodes
sample-and-hold public book with mandatory adverse depth and impact scenarios
limitations: F2 evidence is a limited snapshot model, not observed fills or queue precision
scenario ranges are conditional, not statistical confidence intervals
hypothetical scale does not empirically validate endogenous market impact
derivatives, borrow, cross-currency, passive and order/account-level claims are blocked
dependencies: signed applied G5 package and exact original instrument/data hashes
effective-dated venue rules, account state and fee source inputs
Python Decimal and shared persisted inputs are declared common-mode dependencies
independent native sweep, fee-selection and latency implementations
moving-average ledger and independent FIFO reconciliation
validation: hand-derived profitable and friction-destroyed edge fixtures
fault-injected fee, quantity, price and latency disagreement blocks
causal in-flight acknowledgement and delayed terminal-loss regressions
source-bound acceptance evidence and immutable G5 comparisons

models.purpose: Regularized covariance for portfolio attribution; outputs are MODEL_ESTIMATE.
limitations: does not establish alpha or independent empirical evidence
